blocks.task_summary: Find the number of ways 5 people can be seated next to each other in a row of 10 empty seats.
method_path: Treat the 5 people as a contiguous block
Count block positions: 10 minus 5 plus 1 equals 6

blocks.task_summary: Find the number of ways 4 girls and Peter can be seated in 10 seats such that no girl sits adjacent to Peter; girls need not sit together.
method_path: Identify two cases: Peter at an end vs Peter not at an end
Case 1 (Peter at either end): 2 times 8P4 equals 3360
Case 2 (Peter not at end): 8 times 7P4 equals 6720
accepted_alternatives: METHOD 2 complement: 10P5 minus arrangements where Peter adjacent to at least one girl. Case 1: Peter at end next to girl gives 2 times 4 times 8P3 equals 2688. Case 2: Peter not at end gives 8 times 2 times 4 times 7P3 plus 8 times 4 times 3 times 7P2 equals 17472. Total: 10P5 minus (2688 plus 17472) equals 10080.
Combination-based: case 1 as 8C4 times 2 times 4! equals 3360; case 2 as 7C4 times 8 times 4! equals 6720

evidence.basis: METHOD 1: case 1 Peter at either end 8P4x2=3360 OR 8C4x2x4!=3360 (A1); case 2 Peter not at end 7P4x8=6720 (A1); Total=3360+6720=10080 A1
METHOD 2: case 1 Peter at end 8P3x2x4=2688 (A1); case 2 Peter not at end (7P3x8x2x4)+(7P2x4x3)=17472 (A1); Total=10P5-(2688+17472)=10080 A1
